question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

HUGE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Big**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Huge **means very large or extensive.

 
 
• Example - *They're having a **huge **sale tomorrow.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Big means large in size or amount.
 
 
• Example - They had a **big **argument yesterday.
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Huge' and 'Big' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Far means a great distance in space or time.
 
• **Small **means not large in size, number, amount, etc.
 
• **Embrace **means to hold someone close to you with your arms to express affection, love, or sympathy.
